title: Offer a Codex account recheck after transient managed startup failures
outcome: An operator can retry managed account verification after a transient startup failure without a new browser authorization or restarting TermAl.
acceptance: A loopback operator can request read-only verification after a transient reconciliation failure. The request observes the current managed grant without mutating the provider or standalone store, opens dispatch on complete successful verification, and keeps dispatch fenced on a failed or inconsistent read. A disposable fixture observes both outcomes.
